title: QUIC: update support for QUICv2 draft-01
description:
With this new version, packet types are version dependent.\
Support for v2-00 has been removed (it has never been used in real
networks and it is incompatible with v2-01)

Some examples:\
[quic-v2-01_retry.pcapng](/uploads/105063e64a6ee4d75271f9e32634f6a0/quic-v2-01_retry.pcapng)\
[quic-v2-01_upgrade_from_v1_to_v2.pcapng](/uploads/40c0ddf0875490ab40886ef49bc66ced/quic-v2-01_upgrade_from_v1_to_v2.pcapng)\
[quic-v2-01.pcapng](/uploads/10d5fcc472df0a7b5c9f214f558a70ed/quic-v2-01.pcapng)

notes.body: i think, we can kept this value
Just to be sure: do you want to *only* keep this value in this structure, or do you want to keep support for v2-draft-00?

Sorry, but I don't understand. We set the correct field depending on the version.
For every versions up to V1 we use V1 field; for newer versions (V2) we use V2 field

What am I missing?
Maybe I got the issue now: the Clang warning....
No, it is may be better to check if it is version 2 and display v2 and by default use v1 ?
